Messages.Author: CryWolf
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

Vamps A and B, controlled by different Methuselahs, are contesting the Ivory Bow. Vamp A's controller plays Anachronism on Vamp B. What happens?

A) Ivory Bow on Vamp B burns and Vamp A gets it back on his next untap
B) Nothing, since Ivory Bow is out-of-play and no effects can affect it until it is back in play

Cry Wolf

Messages.Author: jozxyqk
Messages.Body: Trick question, since Anachronism specifically leaves the Ivory Bow alone?

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
> CryWolf wrote:
> Hello LSJ,
>
> Vamps A and B, controlled by different Methuselahs, are contesting the Waxen Poetica. Vamp A's controller plays Anachronism on Vamp B. What happens?
>
> A) Waxen Poetica on Vamp B burns and Vamp A gets it back on his next untap
> B) Nothing, since Waxen Poetica is out-of-play and no effects can affect it until it is back in play
B. And once it ceases to be contested, if B's copy is the one that remains, it is burned by Anachronism's text.

Messages.Author: CryWolf
Messages.Body:
Uber fail.

But thanks for answering the thought behind the question.

Cry Wolf
